units.headline: New test helper samples refs at even intervals
units.summary: New benchmark helper that picks count refs spread evenly across the input. It is test-only and the indexing stays in bounds because i*step < len(refs).
units.reason: New test-only helper; cannot affect production.

units.headline: New benchmark for filterSeriesAndSortPostings across input fractions
units.summary: New benchmark that builds a 100k-series head and times filterSeriesAndSortPostings with the OOO predicate. It is test-only.
units.reason: New benchmark only; no production effect.

units.headline: staleIndex renamed to selectedSeriesIndex with renamed types
units.summary: The constructor body is unchanged. Only the function, type and field names changed, and every caller (SelectedSeriesHead.Index) uses the new names.
units.reason: Rename of unexported identifiers with all uses updated; same logic.

units.headline: headStaleIndexReader renamed to headSelectedSeriesIndexReader
units.summary: The unexported type and its field are renamed and the doc comment rewritten. The struct still has the same shape.
units.reason: Unexported type rename with all uses updated; no serialized shape.

units.summary: Same intersect logic as before; only the receiver type and field names changed.
units.reason: Pure rename of unexported identifiers; logic identical.

units.headline: staleSeriesRefs type renamed to seriesRefs
units.summary: Unexported struct renamed and its fields left unchanged. It is not serialized anywhere.
units.reason: Unexported type rename with all uses updated.

units.headline: Generic ref filter with keep predicate replaces stale-only lookup
units.summary: The stale-series lookup is generalized into a filter that takes any postings and an optional predicate, and returns refs in input order plus refs sorted by labels. It now receives caller-supplied ref lists from CompactSelectedSeries, so its output is no longer guaranteed to be sorted or free of duplicates.
focus: Callers passing unsorted or duplicate refs: sortedByRef is returned in input order, not sorted by ref
Duplicate refs give duplicate entries in sortedByLabels, which then feed the block index writer
nil keep skips locking entirely; check this is acceptable for callers

issues.title: Duplicate or unsorted caller refs are not deduplicated or sorted
issues.evidence:
sortedByRef = append(sortedByRef, ref)
		keptSeries = append(keptSeries, s)
issues.failure_scenario: CompactSelectedSeries([]SeriesRef{r, r}) puts the same series twice in sortedByLabels. The block writer gets identical label sets one after another and the index writer rejects them as out of order, so the compaction fails. NumSeries also overcounts, and sortedByRef is not ref-sorted for Intersect.

units.reason: Core filtering logic now serves a new public compaction API with arbitrary inputs.

units.headline: Stale-ref lookup now delegates to filterSeriesAndSortPostings
units.summary: Same no-OOO and stale-NaN checks, still made under the series lock and still applied to all postings. Only the log text changed ('stale series not found' became 'series not found'), so behavior is otherwise the same.
units.reason: Equivalent refactor; the predicates match the removed inline checks.
